mechanism: Decomposes a {{task}} into a fixed {{sequence}} of LLM calls. Each step's output is validated against an {{accept_spec}} before it is passed to the next, and a failed output is never forwarded. After a failed validation, the chain invokes {{re_attempt}} on that step up to `max_retries_per_step`; when that budget is exhausted, it halts without executing the next step. A value of zero halts on the first failed validation. It orchestrates {{tool_invoke}} calls and applies {{input_guard}} validation at each boundary.
gloss: Sequential LLM calls with validation gates
failure_modes: Undetected error propagation: a flawed intermediate output passes validation and corrupts the next step.
Validation brittleness: an overly narrow {{accept_spec}} rejects a valid intermediate output.
invariants: No failed-forwarding: the {{chain}} never passes a failed step's output to the next step.
Schema Continuity: Output(N) must satisfy InputSchema(N+1).
Bounded recovery: a failed step is re-attempted no more than `max_retries_per_step`; exhaustion halts the {{chain}} before the next step executes.

parameters.name: max_retries_per_step
parameters.description: Re-attempts allowed after a failed step; 0 halts on the first failure
